{{Quote|I now pronounce you, Lula Talisola and Zeen Mrala, married amidst the stars and seas of the Seswenna sector!|[[Maz Kanata]]|<ref name="High Republic Wedding Spectacular">''[[The High Republic Adventures Phase III - The Wedding Spectacular]]''</ref>}}
The '''Seswenna sector''' was a [[sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] of [[the galaxy]]. It notably contained the [[planet]] [[Eriadu]]<ref name="Tarkin" /> and [[Seswenna]] itself,<ref name="Ultimate">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> and was traversed by the [[Hydian Way]]<ref name="Tarkin" /> and the [[Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="Entertainment Weekly Rogue One" /> In [[228 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{StarlightDate|[[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 4|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2023) 4]]|one [[Standard year|year]] and two weeks after the destruction of Starlight Beacon|[[228 BBY]]}} Since the events of [[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 6|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2023) 6]] are set immediately following the fourth issue's events and depict the [[expansion of the Stormwall]], the latter event must take place in the same year.</ref> the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]] expanded the [[Stormwall]], and part of the sector became part of the [[Occlusion Zone]].<ref name="EoD" /> 

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Seswenna sector is misspelled as Seswanna sector on page 341 of the novel ''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]''. Other mentions of the Seswenna sector in the novel follow the proper spelling.<ref name="EoD" />
